create_graph_dataset: create a GraphDataset instance from a JSON file for train, dev, or test splits
build_adjacency_matrix: build an adjacency matrix with self-connections and a virtual node from graph data
normalize_edge_weights: normalize edge weights in the adjacency matrix using the normalize_weight utility function
encode_node_features: encode integer node features into one-hot vectors with padding to match expected feature dimensions
retrieve_graph_item: retrieve a graph item by index returning node features, adjacency matrix, weights, and labels
